from __future__ import annotations
# pyright: reportImplicitRelativeImport=false

import json
import os
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

from orchestrator_harness.cli import _store
from orchestrator_harness.config import (
    ConfigError,
    load_config,
    path_identity,
    same_path,
)
from orchestrator_harness.stable_io import (
    PathSafetyError,
    SafeOutput,
    UnstableReadError,
    read_stable,
)
from orchestrator_harness.tests.support import SuiteFixture, write_json


class ConfigAndStoreTests(unittest.TestCase):
    fixture: SuiteFixture  # pyright: ignore[reportUninitializedInstanceVariable]

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.fixture = SuiteFixture.create()

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.fixture.close()

    def test_path_identity_uses_platform_case_and_separator_rules(self) -> None:
        left = self.fixture.suite_root / "Runs" / "lane"
        right = self.fixture.suite_root / "Runs" / "lane" / "."
        self.assertEqual(path_identity(left), path_identity(right))
        if os.name == "nt":
            self.assertTrue(same_path(str(left).upper(), str(left).lower()))
        else:
            self.assertNotEqual(
                path_identity(str(left).upper()), path_identity(str(left).lower())
            )

    def test_config_accepts_bounded_record_declarations(self) -> None:
        write_json(
            self.fixture.config_path,
            {
                "suite_root": str(self.fixture.suite_root),
                "run_globs": ["runs/*"],
                "record_paths": ["nested/helper.json"],
                "record_manifests": ["record-manifest.json"],
            },
        )
        config = load_config(
            self.fixture.config_path, harness_root=self.fixture.harness_root
        )
        self.assertEqual(("nested/helper.json",), config.record_paths)
        self.assertEqual(("record-manifest.json",), config.record_manifests)

    def test_config_rejects_parent_glob(self) -> None:
        write_json(
            self.fixture.config_path,
            {
                "suite_root": str(self.fixture.suite_root),
                "run_globs": ["../*"],
                "output_dir": ".state",
            },
        )
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load_config(
                self.fixture.config_path, harness_root=self.fixture.harness_root
            )

    def test_config_rejects_wide_pid_creation_tolerance(self) -> None:
        write_json(
            self.fixture.config_path,
            {
                "suite_root": str(self.fixture.suite_root),
                "run_globs": ["fresh-experiments/*"],
                "output_dir": ".state",
                "process_start_tolerance_seconds": 3,
            },
        )
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load_config(
                self.fixture.config_path, harness_root=self.fixture.harness_root
            )

    def test_cli_permits_only_multi_agent_logs_outside_harness_root(self) -> None:
        allowed = self.fixture.suite_root / "multi-agent-logs" / "epoch"
        write_json(
            self.fixture.config_path,
            {
                "suite_root": str(self.fixture.suite_root),
                "run_globs": ["runs/*"],
                "output_dir": str(allowed),
            },
        )
        config = load_config(
            self.fixture.config_path, harness_root=self.fixture.harness_root
        )
        self.assertEqual(allowed, _store(config).output_root)

        for forbidden in (
            self.fixture.suite_root / "arbitrary-sibling",
            self.fixture.suite_root / "fresh-experiments" / "epoch",
        ):
            write_json(
                self.fixture.config_path,
                {
                    "suite_root": str(self.fixture.suite_root),
                    "run_globs": ["runs/*"],
                    "output_dir": str(forbidden),
                },
            )
            config = load_config(
                self.fixture.config_path, harness_root=self.fixture.harness_root
            )
            with self.assertRaises(PathSafetyError):
                _store(config)

    def test_output_rejects_observed_root(self) -> None:
        store = SafeOutput(
            harness_root=self.fixture.root,
            output_root=self.fixture.suite_root / "fresh-experiments" / "state",
            forbidden_roots=(self.fixture.suite_root / "fresh-experiments",),
        )
        with self.assertRaises(PathSafetyError):
            store.prepare()

    def test_output_allows_sibling_of_observed_root(self) -> None:
        parent = self.fixture.harness_root / "run"
        observed = parent / "synthetic-suite" / ".agent-workspace"
        observed.mkdir(parents=True)
        store = SafeOutput(
            harness_root=self.fixture.harness_root,
            output_root=parent / "watcher-state",
            forbidden_roots=(observed,),
        )
        store.prepare()
        self.assertTrue(store.output_root.is_dir())

    def test_output_rejects_reparse_component(self) -> None:
        target = self.fixture.harness_root / "link" / "state"
        with patch("orchestrator_harness.stable_io._is_reparse") as mocked:
            mocked.side_effect = lambda path: path.name == "link"
            (self.fixture.harness_root / "link").mkdir()
            store = SafeOutput(
                harness_root=self.fixture.harness_root,
                output_root=target,
                forbidden_roots=(),
            )
            with self.assertRaises(PathSafetyError):
                store.prepare()

    @unittest.skipUnless(os.name == "nt", "Windows ADS rule")
    def test_output_rejects_ads(self) -> None:
        store = SafeOutput(
            harness_root=self.fixture.harness_root,
            output_root=self.fixture.harness_root / "state:stream",
            forbidden_roots=(),
        )
        with self.assertRaises(PathSafetyError):
            store.prepare()

    def test_output_root_replacement_is_detected(self) -> None:
        store = SafeOutput(
            harness_root=self.fixture.harness_root,
            output_root=self.fixture.harness_root / "state",
            forbidden_roots=(),
        )
        store.prepare()
        original = self.fixture.harness_root / "state"
        moved = self.fixture.harness_root / "state-old"
        original.rename(moved)
        original.mkdir()
        with self.assertRaises(PathSafetyError):
            store.atomic_json(store.snapshot_path, {"x": 1})

    def test_event_append_precedes_cursor_and_survives_injected_crash(self) -> None:
        store = SafeOutput(
            harness_root=self.fixture.harness_root,
            output_root=self.fixture.harness_root / "state",
            forbidden_roots=(),
            fail_after_event_append=True,
        )
        store.prepare()
        event = {"event_id": "same", "identity": "x", "type": "X"}
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            store.commit(snapshot={"n": 1}, events=[event], conditions={"x": event})
        self.assertTrue(store.events_path.exists())
        self.assertFalse(store.snapshot_path.exists())
        logged = json.loads(store.events_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip())
        self.assertEqual("same", logged["event_id"])

    def test_unstable_stat_read_stat_fails_closed(self) -> None:
        path = self.fixture.harness_root / "changing.json"
        path.write_text('{"x": 1}', encoding="utf-8")
        with patch(
            "orchestrator_harness.stable_io._signature",
            side_effect=[(1, 1, 1, 1), (2, 2, 2, 2)] * 2,
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(UnstableReadError):
                read_stable(
                    path,
                    max_bytes=100,
                    retries=2,
                    delay_seconds=0,
                )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    def _write_canonical_json(path: Path, value: dict[str, object]) -> str:

        ).encode("utf-8")
        path.write_bytes(data)
        return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

        """Explicit diagnostics for removed policy keys, never live settings."""

        return self.legacy_config_diagnostics

    @property
    def forbidden_output_roots(self) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
        return (
            self.suite_root / ".agent-workspace",
            self.suite_root / "fresh-experiments",
            self.suite_root / "BYO-Firmware-MCP",
        )


def _number(raw: dict[str, Any], key: str, default: float, *, minimum: float) -> float:
    value = raw.get(key, default)
    if not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or isinstance(value, bool):
        raise ConfigError(f"{key} must be numeric")
    result = float(value)
    if not math.isfinite(result):
        raise ConfigError(f"{key} must be finite")
    if result < minimum:
        raise ConfigError(f"{key} must be >= {minimum}")
    return result


def _integer(raw: dict[str, Any], key: str, default: int, *, minimum: int) -> int:
    value = raw.get(key, default)
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
        raise ConfigError(f"{key} must be an integer")
    if value < minimum:
        raise ConfigError(f"{key} must be >= {minimum}")
    return value


def _declared_relative_paths(
    raw: dict[str, Any], key: str, aliases: tuple[str, ...] = ()
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    value: object = raw.get(key)
    if value is None:
        for alias in aliases:
            if alias in raw:
                value = raw[alias]
                break
    if value is None:
        return ()
    if not isinstance(value, list) or any(
        not isinstance(item, str)
        or not item.strip()
        or Path(item).is_absolute()
        or ".." in Path(item).parts
        for item in value
    ):
        raise ConfigError(f"{key} must be a list of safe relative paths")
    return tuple(item.strip() for item in value)


def load_config(
    path: str | Path,
    *,
    harness_root: Path | None = None,
) -> HarnessConfig:
    config_path = Path(path).resolve()
    try:
        raw = json.loads(config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ConfigError(f"cannot load config {config_path}: {exc}") from exc
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        raise ConfigError("config root must be a JSON object")

    root = (harness_root or Path(__file__).resolve().parent).resolve()
    base = config_path.parent
    suite_value = raw.get("suite_root", "..")
    if not isinstance(suite_value, str) or not suite_value:
        raise ConfigError("suite_root must be a non-empty path string")
    suite_root = (base / suite_value).resolve()

    globs = raw.get("run_globs", ["worktrees/*"])
    if (
        not isinstance(globs, list)
        or not globs
        or any(not isinstance(item, str) or not item for item in globs)
    ):
        raise ConfigError("run_globs must be a non-empty list of strings")
    if any(Path(item).is_absolute() or ".." in Path(item).parts for item in globs):
        raise ConfigError("run_globs must be relative and may not contain '..'")

    workspace = raw.get("workspace_relpath", ".agent-workspace")
    if (
        not isinstance(workspace, str)
        or not workspace
        or Path(workspace).is_absolute()
        or ".." in Path(workspace).parts
    ):
        raise ConfigError("workspace_relpath must be a safe relative path")

    record_paths = _declared_relative_paths(raw, "record_paths", ("observation_paths",))
    record_manifests = _declared_relative_paths(
        raw, "record_manifests", ("record_manifest_paths",)
    )

    output_value = raw.get("output_dir", ".state")
    if not isinstance(output_value, str) or not output_value:
        raise ConfigError("output_dir must be a non-empty path string")
    output = Path(output_value)
    if not output.is_absolute():
        output = root / output

    warning = _integer(raw, "request_warning_seconds", 120, minimum=1)
    critical = _integer(raw, "request_critical_seconds", 30, minimum=0)
    if critical >= warning:
        raise ConfigError("request_critical_seconds must be less than warning")

    process_tolerance = _integer(raw, "process_start_tolerance_seconds", 2, minimum=0)
    if process_tolerance > 2:
        raise ConfigError("process_start_tolerance_seconds must be <= 2")

    max_json_bytes = _integer(raw, "max_json_bytes", 4_000_000, minimum=1024)
    max_jsonl_tail_bytes = _integer(raw, "max_jsonl_tail_bytes", 512_000, minimum=1024)
    stable_read_retries = _integer(raw, "stable_read_retries", 4, minimum=1)
    removed_keys = (
        "manager_heartbeat_timeout_seconds",
        "attention_logging_enabled",
        "attention_epoch_id",
        "attention_sprint_lifetime_seconds",
        "attention_tolerance_seconds",
        "manager_review_interval_seconds",
        "lane_no_progress_seconds",
        "watcher_ack_policy",
        "managed_runtime_path",
        "pending_notification_path",
    )
    legacy_diagnostics = tuple(
        f"legacy configuration key {key!r} is retained only for read compatibility and has no S4 runtime effect"
        for key in removed_keys
        if key in raw
    )

    return HarnessConfig(
        config_path=config_path,
        harness_root=root,
        suite_root=suite_root,
        run_globs=tuple(globs),
        workspace_relpath=workspace,
        output_dir=output,
        poll_interval_seconds=_number(raw, "poll_interval_seconds", 1.0, minimum=0.05),
        watch_timeout_seconds=_number(raw, "watch_timeout_seconds", 60.0, minimum=0.1),
        request_warning_seconds=warning,
        request_critical_seconds=critical,
        process_start_tolerance_seconds=process_tolerance,
        max_json_bytes=max_json_bytes,
        max_jsonl_tail_bytes=max_jsonl_tail_bytes,
        stable_read_retries=stable_read_retries,
        stable_read_delay_seconds=_number(
            raw, "stable_read_delay_seconds", 0.03, minimum=0
        ),
        record_paths=record_paths,
        record_manifests=record_manifests,
        legacy_config_diagnostics=legacy_diagnostics,
    )

1	"""Immutable, byte-exact prompt bundle primitives.
2	
3	The controller only sends bytes that have been verified against this bundle.  A
4	bundle is deliberately a small value object instead of a prompt templating
5	system: callers provide the ordered components and the resulting bytes are
6	bound by both their individual hashes and a manifest hash.
7	"""
8	
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import hashlib
12	import json
13	from dataclasses import dataclass
14	from pathlib import Path
15	from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping, Sequence
16	
17	from .stable_io import canonical_json
18	
19	
20	PROMPT_BUNDLE_SCHEMA = "orchestrator-prompt-bundle/v1"
21	_SHA256_LENGTH = 64
22	
23	
24	class PromptBundleError(ValueError):
25	    """Raised when a prompt bundle is malformed, stale, or tampered with."""
26	
27	
28	def _sha256(data: bytes) -> str:
29	    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
30	
31	
32	def _digest(value: Any) -> str:
33	    return _sha256(canonical_json(value).encode("utf-8"))
34	
35	
36	def _text(value: object, name: str) -> str:
37	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
38	        raise PromptBundleError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")
39	    return value.strip()
40	
41	
42	def _digest_text(value: object, name: str) -> str:
43	    result = _text(value, name).lower()
44	    if len(result) != _SHA256_LENGTH or any(
45	        c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in result
46	    ):
47	        raise PromptBundleError(f"{name} must be a SHA-256 hex digest")
48	    return result
49	
50	
51	def _safe_component_path(path: Path, root: Path) -> Path:
52	    if not path.is_absolute():
53	        path = root / path
54	    if path.is_symlink():
55	        raise PromptBundleError("prompt component path cannot be a symlink")
56	    candidate = path.expanduser().resolve(strict=False)
57	    root_resolved = root.expanduser().resolve(strict=False)
58	    try:
59	        candidate.relative_to(root_resolved)
60	    except ValueError as exc:
61	        raise PromptBundleError("prompt component path escapes run root") from exc
62	    if not candidate.is_file():
63	        raise PromptBundleError(
64	            "prompt component path must be an existing regular file"
65	        )
66	    return candidate
67	
68	
69	@dataclass(frozen=True)
70	class PromptComponent:
71	    """One ordered prompt byte source."""
72	
73	    component_id: str
74	    content: bytes
75	    path: Path | None = None
76	
77	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
78	        if not isinstance(self.component_id, str) or not self.component_id.strip():
79	            raise PromptBundleError("prompt component ID must be non-empty")
80	        if not isinstance(self.content, bytes):
81	            raise PromptBundleError("prompt component content must be bytes")
82	
83	    @property
84	    def sha256(self) -> str:
85	        return _sha256(self.content)
86	
87	    @property
88	    def size(self) -> int:
89	        return len(self.content)
90	
91	    def record(self, *, ordinal: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
92	        return {
93	            "id": self.component_id,
94	            "ordinal": ordinal,
95	            "path": str(self.path) if self.path is not None else None,
96	            "sha256": self.sha256,
97	            "size": self.size,
98	        }
99	
100	
101	@dataclass(frozen=True)
102	class PromptBundle:
103	    """A frozen ordered prompt and the identities that bind it."""
104	
105	    workflow_id: str
106	    task_card_id: str
107	    profile_id: str
108	    components: tuple[PromptComponent, ...]
109	    final_bytes: bytes
110	    final_sha256: str
111	    bundle_sha256: str
112	    schema: str = PROMPT_BUNDLE_SCHEMA
113	    version: int = 1
114	
115	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
116	        if self.schema != PROMPT_BUNDLE_SCHEMA or self.version != 1:
117	            raise PromptBundleError("unsupported prompt bundle schema")
118	        _text(self.workflow_id, "workflow_id")
119	        _text(self.task_card_id, "task_card_id")
120	        _text(self.profile_id, "profile_id")
121	        if not self.components:
122	            raise PromptBundleError("prompt bundle must contain at least one component")
123	        ids = [component.component_id for component in self.components]
124	        if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
125	            raise PromptBundleError("prompt component IDs must be unique")
126	        composed = b"".join(component.content for component in self.components)
127	        if composed != self.final_bytes:
128	            raise PromptBundleError(
129	                "prompt final bytes do not match ordered components"
130	            )
131	        if _sha256(self.final_bytes) != self.final_sha256:
132	            raise PromptBundleError("prompt final SHA-256 does not match bytes")
133	        if self.bundle_sha256 != self.manifest_sha256():
134	            raise PromptBundleError("prompt bundle SHA-256 does not match manifest")
135	
136	    @property
137	    def content_sha256(self) -> str:
138	        """Alias used by status/result records for the exact sent buffer."""
139	
140	        return self.final_sha256
141	
142	    def manifest(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
143	        return {
144	            "schema": self.schema,
145	            "version": self.version,
146	            "workflow_id": self.workflow_id,
147	            "task_card_id": self.task_card_id,
148	            "profile_id": self.profile_id,
149	            "components": [
150	                component.record(ordinal=index)
151	                for index, component in enumerate(self.components)
152	            ],
153	            "final_sha256": self.final_sha256,
154	            "final_size": len(self.final_bytes),
155	        }
156	
157	    def manifest_sha256(self) -> str:
158	        return _digest(self.manifest())
159	
160	    def to_record(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
161	        record = dict(self.manifest())
162	        record["bundle_sha256"] = self.bundle_sha256
163	        return record
164	
165	    def verify(self, components: Sequence[PromptComponent]) -> None:
166	        candidate = compose_prompt_bundle(
167	            workflow_id=self.workflow_id,
168	            task_card_id=self.task_card_id,
169	            profile_id=self.profile_id,
170	            components=components,
171	        )
172	        if candidate.to_record() != self.to_record():
173	            raise PromptBundleError("prompt bundle identity changed")
174	
175	
176	def compose_prompt_bundle(
177	    *,
178	    workflow_id: str,
179	    task_card_id: str,
180	    profile_id: str,
181	    components: Iterable[PromptComponent | tuple[str, bytes]],
182	) -> PromptBundle:
183	    normalized: list[PromptComponent] = []
184	    for item in components:
185	        if isinstance(item, PromptComponent):
186	            normalized.append(item)
187	        elif isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 2:
188	            normalized.append(PromptComponent(item[0], item[1]))
189	        else:
190	            raise PromptBundleError(
191	                "components must be PromptComponent values or (id, bytes) pairs"
192	            )
193	    final_bytes = b"".join(component.content for component in normalized)
194	    final_sha256 = _sha256(final_bytes)
195	    provisional = PromptBundle.__new__(PromptBundle)
196	    object.__setattr__(provisional, "workflow_id", _text(workflow_id, "workflow_id"))
197	    object.__setattr__(provisional, "task_card_id", _text(task_card_id, "task_card_id"))
198	    object.__setattr__(provisional, "profile_id", _text(profile_id, "profile_id"))
199	    object.__setattr__(provisional, "components", tuple(normalized))
200	    object.__setattr__(provisional, "final_bytes", final_bytes)
201	    object.__setattr__(provisional, "final_sha256", final_sha256)
202	    object.__setattr__(provisional, "schema", PROMPT_BUNDLE_SCHEMA)
203	    object.__setattr__(provisional, "version", 1)
204	    object.__setattr__(provisional, "bundle_sha256", "")
205	    bundle_sha256 = provisional.manifest_sha256()
206	    object.__setattr__(provisional, "bundle_sha256", bundle_sha256)
207	    PromptBundle.__post_init__(provisional)
208	    return provisional
209	
210	
211	def bundle_from_record(record: Mapping[str, Any], *, run_root: Path) -> PromptBundle:
212	    """Read and verify a path-bound bundle record under ``run_root``."""
213	
214	    required = {
215	        "schema",
216	        "version",
217	        "workflow_id",
218	        "task_card_id",
219	        "profile_id",
220	        "components",
221	        "final_sha256",
222	        "final_size",
223	        "bundle_sha256",
224	    }
225	    if set(record) != required:
226	        raise PromptBundleError("prompt bundle has an invalid closed shape")
227	    if record.get("schema") != PROMPT_BUNDLE_SCHEMA or record.get("version") != 1:
228	        raise PromptBundleError("prompt bundle schema/version is invalid")
229	    components_value = record.get("components")
230	    if not isinstance(components_value, list) or not components_value:
231	        raise PromptBundleError("prompt bundle components must be a non-empty list")
232	    components: list[PromptComponent] = []
233	    for ordinal, raw in enumerate(components_value):
234	        if not isinstance(raw, Mapping) or set(raw) != {
235	            "id",
236	            "ordinal",
237	            "path",
238	            "sha256",
239	            "size",
240	        }:
241	            raise PromptBundleError(
242	                "prompt bundle component has an invalid closed shape"
243	            )
244	        if raw.get("ordinal") != ordinal:
245	            raise PromptBundleError("prompt bundle component order is not contiguous")
246	        path_value = raw.get("path")
247	        if not isinstance(path_value, str) or not path_value:
248	            raise PromptBundleError(
249	                "prompt bundle components require path-bound sources"
250	            )
251	        path = _safe_component_path(Path(path_value), run_root)
252	        try:
253	            content = path.read_bytes()
254	        except OSError as exc:
255	            raise PromptBundleError(f"cannot read prompt component: {exc}") from exc
256	        expected_size = raw.get("size")
257	        if (
258	            not isinstance(expected_size, int)
259	            or isinstance(expected_size, bool)
260	            or expected_size != len(content)
261	        ):
262	            raise PromptBundleError("prompt component size does not match bytes")
263	        if _digest_text(raw.get("sha256"), "prompt component sha256") != _sha256(
264	            content
265	        ):
266	            raise PromptBundleError("prompt component bytes do not match sha256")
267	        components.append(
268	            PromptComponent(_text(raw.get("id"), "prompt component id"), content, path)
269	        )
270	    bundle = compose_prompt_bundle(
271	        workflow_id=_text(record.get("workflow_id"), "workflow_id"),
272	        task_card_id=_text(record.get("task_card_id"), "task_card_id"),
273	        profile_id=_text(record.get("profile_id"), "profile_id"),
274	        components=components,
275	    )
276	    if not isinstance(record.get("final_size"), int) or record["final_size"] != len(
277	        bundle.final_bytes
278	    ):
279	        raise PromptBundleError("prompt final size does not match bytes")
280	    if bundle.to_record() != dict(record):
281	        raise PromptBundleError("prompt bundle manifest is stale or tampered")
282	    return bundle
283	
284	
285	def prompt_bundle_record_from_paths(
286	    *,
287	    workflow_id: str,
288	    task_card_id: str,
289	    profile_id: str,
290	    paths: Sequence[tuple[str, Path]],
291	    run_root: Path,
292	) -> dict[str, Any]:
293	    components = []
294	    for component_id, path in paths:
295	        safe = _safe_component_path(path, run_root)
296	        components.append(PromptComponent(component_id, safe.read_bytes(), safe))
297	    return compose_prompt_bundle(
298	        workflow_id=workflow_id,
299	        task_card_id=task_card_id,
300	        profile_id=profile_id,
301	        components=components,
302	    ).to_record()
303	
304	
305	__all__ = [
306	    "PROMPT_BUNDLE_SCHEMA",
307	    "PromptBundle",
308	    "PromptBundleError",
309	    "PromptComponent",
310	    "bundle_from_record",
311	    "compose_prompt_bundle",
312	    "prompt_bundle_record_from_paths",
313	]

"""Compatibility detection: canonical invocation schema & validation rules.

exactly one field, and asserts the real validator's rejection (or documents the
actual behavior when it differs from the plan).  No provider subprocess is
launched and no harness source module is modified.

The canonical baseline is copied verbatim from ``test_s2_contract._canonical``
so the two suites share the exact fixture shape.

from orchestrator_harness.profile import RuntimeProfile

)
from orchestrator_harness.provider import ProviderAdapterError

CODING_INVOCATION_SCHEMA = "orchestrator-coding-invocation/v1"


class CompatInvocationRulesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _canonical(self, root: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, object], object]:
        """One valid ``orchestrator-worker-invocation/v1`` baseline (s2-identical)."""
        run = root / "run"
        workspace = run / ".agent-workspace"
        workspace.mkdir(parents=True)
        runtime = root / "runtime"
        runtime.mkdir()
        prompt_a = run / "prompt-a.md"

        prompt_a.write_bytes(b"workflow\n")

        card = {
            "schema": TASK_CARD_SCHEMA,
            "card_id": "card-1",
            "lane_id": "lane-1",
            "stage_cohort_id": "cohort-1",
            "worker_invocation_id": "worker-1",

        profile = RuntimeProfile(
            "profile-1",
            "implementer",
            "claude-code",
            "claude-test",
            ("Read",),
            ("repo",),
            ("resource-1",),
            ("CLAUDE_CODE_TEST",),
            ("WORKFLOW_TEST_FLAG",),
        )
        bundle = prompt_bundle_record_from_paths(
            workflow_id="workflow-1",
            task_card_id="card-1",
            profile_id="profile-1",
            paths=(("instructions", prompt_a), ("task", prompt_b)),
            run_root=run,
        )
        value: dict[str, object] = {
            "schema": CANONICAL_INVOCATION_SCHEMA,
            "action": "start",
            "run_root": str(run),
            "runtime_root": str(runtime),
            "lane_id": "lane-1",
            "worker_invocation_id": "worker-1",

                "id": "card-1",

    def _coding_v1_record(self) -> dict[str, object]:

            "action": "start",

    # C2 ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_c2_action_must_be_start_or_resume(self) -> None:

    def test_c6_profile_role_must_match_invocation_role(self) -> None:

    def test_c9_prompt_bundle_schema_and_version_validation(self) -> None:

            root = Path(temporary)
            raw, _ = self._canonical(root)
            self.assertEqual(PROMPT_BUNDLE_SCHEMA, raw["prompt_bundle"]["schema"])  # type: ignore[index]

                InvocationValidationError, "schema/version"

    def test_c10_resume_identity_must_be_an_object(self) -> None:

    def test_c18_canonical_output_path_safety_and_uniqueness(self) -> None:
